assumptions.choice: Data feed is fixed by the harness to AAPL 2020-01-02..2025-12-30, not DJIA constituents 2000-2012 as the spec requires. Ran the strategy unmodified over the full provided feed rather than attempting date-filtering, since filtering to a non-overlapping range would produce no trades at all.
assumptions.reason: spec's test period and universe cannot be satisfied by the fixed single-asset OHLCV feed supplied by the harness

assumptions.choice: Did not attempt to override cerebro's starting cash from within the strategy; left the harness's $10,000 in place instead of the spec's $100,000.
assumptions.reason: cerebro/broker setup is added by the harness and stated as fixed, not the strategy's choice to change

assumptions.choice: Did not call self.broker.setcommission() to force 0.2% broker-level commission; instead added self-contained bookkeeping (total_transaction_costs, gross_pnl, net_pnl) that computes 0.2% of each executed order's trade value and nets it against trade P&L inside the strategy, leaving the harness's actual broker commission at its fixed 0.001.
assumptions.reason: the harness explicitly fixes commission at 0.001 as part of the execution environment, so the spec's 0.2% cost model is implemented as an internal accounting overlay rather than altering real account equity

assumptions.choice: Used self.data.close (the feed's only close series) wherever the spec calls for 'adjusted closing price'.
assumptions.reason: the supplied feed only exposes Open/High/Low/Close/Volume with no adjusted-close column
